title: A worker's brief for a rule-guarding item says how to record an open choice without stopping, and a choice left in prose is refused before landing
goal: SP-befc6yqr: every gate on a bl_ or skill item is classed blocking, while the brief tells a worker to stop on a blocking gate; one worker stopped (ST-qgnjxiol), two applied a choice and named it only in prose (ST-zt4fdewi otherroot, BG-uoexdu6y defaultroot), which the orchestrator recorded by hand. The brief bl_dispatch prints for a rule-guarding item says that the orchestrator pre-asks the open choices and that any further choice is a gate recorded with its recommendation applied; land or done names a report-only choice it can detect, or the rule says how the orchestrator checks.
